subject.title: fix(approvals): fail closed plugin tool gates

question: Should unresolved plugin approvals fail closed immediately even for plugins that still set the accepted legacy timeoutBehavior:"allow" field?
rationale: The implementation closes an execution-authorization gap but deliberately removes authority from an accepted plugin API behavior, so release compatibility intent must be explicit.

options.title: Accept fail-closed cutover
options.body: Keep the field parse-compatible for one release train while making every unresolved approval deny immediately.

options.title: Stage strict semantics
options.body: Preserve timeout allow temporarily and introduce a separately approved strict transition path.

options.title: Pause for combined transition
options.body: Defer this slice until the remaining exec timeout cutover can be reviewed as one authorization release change.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed cutover
recommendation.body: Keep the field parse-compatible for one release train while making every unresolved approval deny immediately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged approval work and the current stacked implementation make this the strongest history-backed owner for the cutover decision.
